type: Post-hoc transcription sensitivity planned during the initial real run, after control validation and partial real outputs.
selection: For each of four language/inventory pairs, freeze the case with smallest held-out unpenalized four-unit score. Apply that exact key to matched Takahashi IT loci; never refit.
purpose: Determine whether aggregate candidate behavior is sensitive to choosing ZL versus IT transcription on shared loci; not proof of correctness, not independent paleography.
limits: Equal encoded sequences can include unknown breaks. Distinct source readings can alter lengths and scored windows, so score differences are descriptive. Not a new prospective held-out test.
